name: @sp-api-sdk/messaging-api-2026-04-20
author: Bertrand Marron <bertrand@bizon.solutions>
description: The Selling Partner API for Messaging Automations allows sellers to programmatically manage automated buyer-seller messaging configurations. An automation configuration defines rules for automatically responding to buyer messages (for example, auto-responses to common questions about shipping, returns, or product details). A seller can create multiple automation configurations, and each configuration can apply to one or more Amazon stores. Each store-specific entry within a configuration contains the response content and the automation trigger conditions. The marketplaceIds query parameter is required on all operations for store-scoped authorization.
